note: Per-family edit capabilities. The Suite owns the operations; a family maps the common edit request onto its own pinned ComfyUI workflow. available=false keeps an operation visible but disabled with its reason. mask: paste_back = the model edits a crop, the Suite pastes it back inside the soft mask; native_mask = the model itself receives the mask; latent_mask = the Suite crops with context, the selection (grown and feathered at the work size) is the sampler's latent noise mask (SetLatentNoiseMask + DifferentialDiffusion) and the result is pasted back through that same soft mask. Sources: docs/plans/film-suite-r3r4-edit-prep.md section 2 and 3b.
